app.title: Padel Buddy
app.description: A deliberately styled starter shell for the live score tracker.

appShell.lead: A deliberately styled starter shell for the live score tracker, set up to carry future match flows without feeling like placeholder scaffolding.

foundation.sectionText: The shell now establishes shared global styles, component-scoped styling, and a responsive presentation layer that works cleanly on desktop and on-court mobile screens.

tanstackShell.title: TanStack Start shell
tanstackShell.detail: Route generation and the client-only bootstrap are already carrying the app frame.

designTokens.title: Shared design tokens
designTokens.detail: Global variables now define the spacing, color, typography, and focus baseline for future UI work.

scopedStyling.title: Scoped component styling
scopedStyling.detail: CSS Modules keep shell presentation isolated while the app grows into new screens and controls.

baseUiCheck.title: Base UI is wired
baseUiCheck.description: This dialog confirms the starter shell can render accessible, styled primitives inside the TanStack Start route.

notFound.title: We could not find that route.
notFound.description: The app foundation is running, but this page does not exist in the current route tree.
notFound.backLink: Go back to the home screen

loading.title: Checking for a saved match
loading.body: Padel Buddy is restoring the current-match workspace before opening the shell.

corrupt.title: Saved match needs recovery
corrupt.body: The current-match record could not be restored safely. Reset the saved match to continue into the app shell.

notice.title: Saved match was reset
notice.body: An older saved match was cleared because it no longer matches the current app schema.

resume.title: Resume saved match?
resume.body: Padel Buddy restored an in-progress current match. Resume keeps the action log and restores the live score state through replay.
